user_questions_test: I can't stop comparing myself to others on social media. It's making me feel worse about my own life.
My sibling and I haven't spoken in months after a huge argument. I don't know if I should reach out first.
I got passed over for a promotion that went to someone with less experience. I feel so undervalued.
My partner wants kids but I'm not sure I ever want to be a parent. I'm terrified this will end our relationship.
I had a miscarriage last month and everyone keeps telling me to just try again. I'm still grieving this loss.
My roommate is extremely messy and it's driving me crazy, but I hate confrontation.
I've been lying to my family about losing my job three months ago. The shame is eating me alive.
My dog of 15 years died yesterday. People keep saying "it's just a pet" but I'm devastated.
I think my best friend is in an abusive relationship but they won't listen to my concerns.
I started therapy last month and I'm not sure my therapist is the right fit. I feel guilty about wanting to switch.
My adult child came out as transgender and I'm struggling to understand. I love them but I'm confused.
I've been having intrusive thoughts about harming myself, even though I don't actually want to die.
My boss takes credit for my work in meetings. I'm angry but afraid speaking up will cost me my job.
I cheated on my partner once, years ago. The guilt still haunts me but telling them would destroy everything.
Everyone in my family is successful except me. I feel like the disappointment at every gathering.
My teenager refuses to speak to me after I found drugs in their room. I don't know how to fix this.
I'm the only one in my friend group without a romantic partner. I feel left behind and lonely.
My elderly parent is showing signs of dementia but refuses to see a doctor. I feel helpless.
I was assaulted at a party last weekend. I haven't told anyone and I'm barely functioning.
I hate my body so much that I avoid mirrors completely. The negative thoughts are constant.
I've been sober for two years but lately the urge to drink again is overwhelming. I don't know how much longer I can hold on.
My mother was just diagnosed with terminal cancer. I'm not ready to lose her and I can't stop crying.
I told my closest friend something deeply personal and they shared it with everyone. I feel completely betrayed.
I'm in my forties and I suddenly don't know who I am anymore. My career, my relationships—none of it feels like me.
I moved to this country years ago and I still don't feel like I belong. I miss home but home doesn't exist anymore.
My child has severe autism and I love them fiercely, but some days I'm so exhausted I can barely function.
I lost everything in a bad investment. I'm facing bankruptcy and I'm too ashamed to tell my family.
I'm a straight-A student but I haven't slept properly in months. I keep pushing myself and I think I'm breaking.
I retired last year and now I have no idea what to do with myself. I feel useless and invisible.
I've had chronic pain for years but doctors keep telling me nothing is wrong. I'm starting to doubt my own sanity.
There's a group at work that deliberately excludes me and mocks me behind my back. Going to the office makes me sick.
I'm caring for my aging parents and my young kids at the same time. I have nothing left for myself.
Since the breakup, all our mutual friends chose my ex. I haven't talked to anyone in weeks.
I finally achieved the goal I worked toward for years, but I feel nothing. Just empty.
I grew up watching my dad hit my mom. Now I'm an adult and those memories still haunt me every day.
I was doing so well with my eating disorder recovery but I've started restricting again. I'm scared.
Everyone comes to me with their problems but when I need help, no one is there. I'm tired of being the strong one.
My partner's drinking is destroying our family. I love them but I can't keep living like this.
I left the religion I grew up in and now my entire community has cut me off. I feel free but completely alone.
I survived the car accident but my friend didn't. I can't stop thinking it should have been me.
